title: receiveTypingIndicators: sender never learns suppression is active
description: Chat/typing returns success normally even when the recipient's Chat has receiveTypingIndicators: false. The sender receives no error, no different response, and no indication that their typing event was dropped. This is a deliberate privacy decision: if the sender received a different response, they could infer the recipient's preference. The opacity closes a side-channel. This is explicitly documented in the Security Considerations section of draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
